<STBG 3,0><TALK 5><NAME 10><BGM 0,0,502><CHAR 5,1,7,0,8><CV 5,1>Foh foh foh!
What brings you here?

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,2,3><CV 1,5>I found something remarkable,
so I came to report it!

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><CV 5,2>Let me see, let me see.
Show me, if you would...
<ITEM COLLECTION01001,1,1><TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,1><CV 5,3>...Oho, what is this!?

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,3>This is a dragon's claw.
A genuine claw is used here.

It is coated in resin to
prevent it from decaying.

Could this be a crown?
But... hmm, this is indeed...

「The worn claw, by its power,
turns knowledge into wisdom.
That is the treasure.」

<CV 5,4>Yes, it matches the tablet's wording.
This is unmistakably a relic!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0><CV 1,15>So this is a <COL C70101FF>≪Relic≫</COL>!
We did it!

<ITEM 0,1,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,2,3><CV 1,26><COL C70101FF><COL C70101FF>≪Relics≫</COL> are the most valuable
of the discoveries here.
A big step toward great explorer!

<TALK 5><NAME 10>And this I am reading is a copy of
the tablet about this island's
relic legend.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,8>Could that be...
the one in the expedition journal...

<TALK 5><NAME 10>So that journal, is it...
It even has that written in it...
This tablet was found on Malakhja Island.

This tablet is the only clue
to the history of the Fractured Isles.

The deciphering is not yet done,
but as you find discoveries,
more will become clear...

Anyway, I'll look into the relic more.
Drop by again if you're nearby.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,2,4><CV 1,12>Thank you!
Please keep up the research!

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0>This relic, and more besides —
the Fractured Isles still hold
many mysteries, many discoveries.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,8><CV 1,4>Yes!
We'll keep discovering more!

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,1>Wait, what...?
The relic is...
<CLS>
